scope: Minimal versioned Boolean obligation interface for the existing one-bug development case. Preserve all prior frozen source/results in place.
regression: v1 proves correct and omitted-equality contracts compile to identical inputs with equality reintroduced. New compiler must retain exactly the supplied obligations.
missing_or_unrepresentable: Unknown, explicit reason. No inference from answer_kind, tokens or free-text clauses; no hidden obligation defaults. Empty/unknown/duplicate obligations rejected.
static_consumer: Reuse hash-pinned old AST/Term/path collection/native Boolean semantics through a narrow subclass/adapter. Evaluate and certify each active obligation separately; attach obligation ID and source-derived witness. Do not add source operations, loops, numeric, helper, SDK or library semantics. Counterexample absence cannot prove safety.
witness_validation: Separate concrete oracle checks the same six known input/return observations by active obligation. Where supported, static path witness attribution evaluates only old Term models without executing source. Do not pass reward observations/gold labels to global static analyzer.
semgrep: Preserve/refer to v1 source-pattern results as unchanged baseline. Do not delete or contract-filter native findings to manufacture sensitivity, and do not relabel heuristics as obligation proofs.
case: Same #544 original and pinned PR561 proposal, opposite False/True, banana/True, exact True/True only. One known development bug family; no new independent dataset or LLM extraction requests.
acceptance: Correct and omitted-equality compiled contracts and actual consumer inputs differ solely by explicit obligation list.
Original False/True at reward1: equals_reference violation under full contract, no violation under valid-token-only contract.
Original banana/True at reward1: validity violation under both contracts; under full contract equality also false.
Patch returns0 on wrong/invalid inputs: no full-credit obligation violated, even if predicate itself false.
Correct True/True returns1 and violates neither obligation.
Missing contract -> explicit Unknown; whole-source weak contract may still Alarm from invalid token.
No inactive obligation evaluated or emitted as a required/violated condition; unknown cases stay Unknown.
All original freezes/manifests/archives preserved; regressions, independent review, frozen rerun and obligation-level tables retained.
